data.content_ref: inline:§11.3 flags are a false positive generated by the adjudication-ritual's own bookkeeping. The mechanism: the flagging system may have a stale-state or double-counting bug where the same failure event (a critic failing on SRC_005) is recorded once in the per-critic verdict (SRC_007, SRC_009) and again in the aggregate ritual audit (§11.3), producing a spurious 'sustained' flag. The nu verdicts (SRC_006, SRC_008) confirming soundness and relevance of the adjudication only validate that the per-critic verdicts were correctly adjudicated — they do not validate that the aggregate ritual-level flag is correctly derived from those verdicts. The causal chain breaks at the aggregation layer.
